law: Judge the rendered product screen, not implementation source code.
Do not waive clipping, overflow, accessibility, security, functional, density, silhouette, reduced-motion, or other deterministic failures.
Use concrete visible evidence. Do not invent hidden product behavior.
A score below the threshold must include at least one actionable finding.
Distinctiveness must serve product purpose; novelty alone is not quality.

dimensions.title: Information hierarchy
dimensions.instruction: Assess whether primary task, secondary information, and actions are visually ordered without ambiguity.

dimensions.title: Typography
dimensions.instruction: Assess legibility, scale contrast, line length, rhythm, and whether typography feels deliberate rather than default-generated.

dimensions.title: Composition
dimensions.instruction: Assess spatial balance, alignment, grouping, whitespace, density, and whether the screen has a coherent visual silhouette.

dimensions.title: Interaction clarity
dimensions.instruction: Assess whether controls, affordances, navigation, state, and next actions are visually understandable at a glance.

dimensions.title: Content believability
dimensions.instruction: Assess whether labels, values, states, and content resemble a credible production workflow rather than demo filler.

dimensions.title: Distinctiveness
dimensions.instruction: Assess whether the product has a memorable, defensible visual point of view without generic AI-dashboard or template aesthetics.

dimensions.title: Brand coherence
dimensions.instruction: Assess whether color, type, iconography, imagery, surfaces, and interaction tone feel like one product system.

dimensions.title: Platform fidelity
dimensions.instruction: Assess whether the interface feels appropriate for its declared platform and usage context rather than a generic web mockup.

dimensions.title: Motion readiness
dimensions.instruction: From the rendered state, assess whether hierarchy and state changes appear suitable for purposeful restrained motion; do not infer unseen animation behavior.

dimensions.title: Production polish
dimensions.instruction: Assess visual precision, consistency, icon/text alignment, edge treatment, controls, states, and whether the screen appears ready for professional use.
